headline: Brazil Treasury Reports US$9.1 Billion Surplus for October
summary: Brazil's Treasury reported a US$9.1 billion surplus for October, the best since 2016, as revenue rose 5.6% and spending slipped 0.2%.
why: Fiscal surplus figures are key indicators of government budget discipline and public debt management.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: A stronger fiscal surplus reduces sovereign borrowing requirements and improves fiscal credibility.
